description: The maximum number of concurrent Remote Desktop connections in the AWS Region. Service quota increase requests up to 50 are automatically approved. Service quota increases can take up to two and a half hours to take effect.
The maximum number of CancelConnection requests per second that you can send in this account in the current Region.
The maximum number of GetConnection requests per second that you can send in this account in the current Region.
The maximum number of ListConnections requests per second that you can send in this account in the current Region.
The maximum number of StartConnection requests per second that you can send in this account in the current Region.
